_meta.status: DRAFT — for human review only. Do NOT copy into frontend/src/locales/ht/common.json until a qualified reviewer approves each string.
_meta.warning: Crisis/safety copy: machine draft only, never ship unreviewed.

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Bouyon — pou revize. Premye pa kal pou 24 premye èdtan yo apre yon rechit ap parèt isit la apre revizyon. Ou pa pou kont ou.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Ou pa pou kont ou. Bouton kriz ki anwo a toujou la — rele oswa voye tèks bay 988, oswa 911 nan ka ijans.

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Jwenn yon kote ki an sekirite pou rete (rele 211 oswa resous lojman lokal)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Jwenn manje pou semèn sa a (rele 211 oswa yon bank manje lokal)

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Enskri nan Medicaid, epi nan SNAP si ou bezwen li

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Èd legal, tretman ak transpò. Anyè sa a pa kouvri manje ni lojman.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Dokiman ou yo ankripte. Se yon fonksyon plan peye; poko gen pri ki fikse.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Plan peye. Poko gen pri ki fikse.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Token yo pa gen okenn valè lajan.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Tcheke kondisyon pawòl oswa probasyon ou ak ofisye ou anvan ou aplike.

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Ti djòb lokal. Tcheke kondisyon pawòl ou ak ofisye ou. Nimewo telefòn pa janm parèt.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Mete chak dat tribinal ak chak tchèk-in sou yon kalandriye

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Tcheke amann ou, frè ou ak restitisyon ou

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Objektif ekonomi ak yon plan preparasyon lojman. Groundwork pa bay lojman epi li pa asosye ak founisè. Pou èd lokal, rele 211.
